# Group

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Group`](gmeow-Group.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Group>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/entities`](../../slices/entities.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A collection of agents treated as a unit without the formal structure of an organization.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Collection`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Collection)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Group`](gmeow-Group.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Collection`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Collection). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Goal And Intention

- **Source:** [`slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/teleology/examples/goal-and-intention.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention)#example-slices-core-teleology-examples-goal-and-intention

```turtle
# --- The commitment: a relator binding the committed agent to a beneficiary,
#     aimed at the same goal — distinct from merely intending; a promise made TO
#     someone (a Commitment is an intentional moment, so it too aims at a goal).
#     The beneficiary must be an Agent — here the employer who sponsored the
#     degree (a gmeow:Group is a gufo:Collection, not an Agent).
ex:commitment a gmeow:Commitment ;
    gmeow:committedAgent        ex:dana ;
    gmeow:commitmentBeneficiary ex:employer ;
    gmeow:intentionGoal         ex:degreeGoal .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for an informal collection of agents treated as a unit but lacking organizational structure — a research team, an audience, a working set of contributors.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a formally constituted body that acts as one agent (use [`gmeow:Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md)) and for a single agent; [`Group`](gmeow-Group.md) is deliberately NOT asserted disjoint with [`Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md), since a structured collective is arguably also a group.

### How to use

- Type the collection as [`gmeow:Group`](gmeow-Group.md) (a [gufo:Collection](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#Collection)) and relate its agents through [`gmeow:hasMember`](../properties/gmeow-hasMember.md) / [`gmeow:memberOf`](../properties/gmeow-memberOf.md); promote to [`gmeow:Organization`](gmeow-Organization.md) only when formal structure and single-agent responsibility must be modelled.

### Examples

- ex:researchTeam a [`gmeow:Group`](gmeow-Group.md); [`gmeow:hasMember`](../properties/gmeow-hasMember.md) ex:lillith, ex:patrick.
